seenByNoStage.description: The exact number of included inventory entries no completed stage covered. Always printed, including zero.

unknownScopeBoundaries.description: Inventory boundaries whose descendants were never enumerated: unknown scope, counted apart, never folded into the exact number above and never read as zero files.

historical.description: Baseline findings the current findings do not continue, by comparison label.

controlAnswers.description: Surface/property answers established, partial or not run; never added to findings.

pathQueries.description: Structural query outcomes, counted separately from findings and security coverage.

reviewObservations.description: Model observations: proposed claims, counted apart from findings and never coverage.

decisionEvaluation.description: Availability of optional source-only owner adjudication, never scanner coverage.

reviews.description: Model observations, by stage and unit: a cited class beside the findings, never folded into them.

provenance.description: What ran for each published unit: implementation, version, where, what it read and wrote, how long, and for a model stage its tokens and cost.

ReportEnvelope.description: sentinel-report/draft-1 — one deterministic projection at a pinned ledger sequence and evaluation time.

Id.description: A ledger identifier. Opaque, bounded and free of path separators and whitespace.

Ordinal.description: A positive integer ordinal or revision.

Timestamp.description: A UTC RFC 3339 timestamp with an explicit Z offset and a real calendar date (no leap second), years 0000–9999 proleptic Gregorian, up to nine fractional digits. The pattern bounds each field; the `date-time` format check refuses a day the month does not have. Comparisons keep all nine digits.

Digest.description: A SHA-256 content address, lower-case hex.

ReportCount.description: A scoped number with exactly core's `Counted` shape: what it counts (`unit`, and `bizUnit` when the business register prints it), over which scope, from which fold, its partition and the command that re-checks it. Unit, scope and part keys are shared-catalog keys; the tests run core's own `countedProblems` over them.

SharedCatalogKey.description: A key in the shared two-register catalog (`count.unit.journeys`, `sentinel.count.findings`).

label.description: A name out of the pinned context, when the part is one thing rather than a kind.

ReportCountPart.description: One part of a count's partition: core's `CountPart`. Parts sum to the count they explain.

BoundedText.description: Untrusted text supplied by a producer (a scanner message, a rationale). Always escaped when rendered.

comparisonReason.description: Why the comparison label was given.

RegisterText.description: The same thing said in both registers; the report carries both so it never looks a label up later.

nodeIds.description: Canonical graph node IDs, the same identities `SourceEvidence.nodeId` carries.

FindingPlace.description: Report-side application placement. Reachability is navigation evidence, never proof of exploitation.

ArtifactId.description: An immutable object-store identity: the digest of canonical uncompressed bytes.

ShortText.description: A short label (a severity as supplied, a framework name).

NodeId.description: A canonical application-graph identity (`repo::path/to/File.tsx::Component`), a screen or a journey ID from pinned context. Unlike a ledger `Id` it may contain `/` and `::`; it is bounded and free of control characters.

PlaceLabel.description: A readable label captured from pinned context, so a recipient never looks one up in today's graph.

CatalogKey.description: A stable code from the Sentinel catalog, never free text (`sentinel.reason.tooLarge`).

ComparisonLabel.description: Why a finding pairs or does not pair with the baseline. Absence alone never resolves an issue.

FindingMatch.description: How a finding paired with the baseline. Probable and ambiguous pairings never resolve or silently continue an issue.

FindingFingerprint.description: Sentinel's versioned issue fingerprint: exact (rule family and anchor set) and probable (rule family and symbols).

ReportEvidence.description: Permitted evidence is embedded; omitted evidence keeps its identity and the reason it was withheld.

EvidenceLocation.description: Where evidence sits in the captured source. Absent for evidence whose location is itself withheld (secrets).

RelativePath.description: A source-relative POSIX path: no leading or trailing slash, no `.`/`..` segment, no empty segment, no backslash or NUL. A newline or other line break inside a name is a legal POSIX name and is kept as captured; the checks use `[\s\S]`, never `.`, so a line break cannot hide a `..` segment from them.

ReportControlInspection.description: Accepted framework inspection answers. Applying or not applying a control is never an issue or an assessment.

WorkRef.description: A logical work unit at one immutable revision; every reference to work names both.

detailLoss.description: A coarse secret match removes sites/spans and replaces all source-controlled identifiers.

ReportStructuralPaths.description: A genuine accepted bounded structural query result. The pinned worker reports these outcomes; readback authenticates their producer/closure and graph identities, never independently proves absence or security.

graphDigest.description: Digest of the canonical node and edge set the search read.

cycles.description: Call cycles met, each as its member nodes (bounded).

PathEvidenceEnvelope.description: sentinel-paths/draft-1 — bounded static call paths over one source's parser analysis, keyed by the analysis fingerprint, a digest of the graph read and the bounds. `establishes` is fixed: a path is call reachability, never data flow, taint or protection.

maxDepth.description: Edges in the longest path explored.

maxFanout.description: Outgoing edges followed per node; beyond it the node is a frontier.

PathEdgeKind.description: The edge kinds a path may follow. Guard, validation and test edges are never traversed: they are not calls.

frontierReasons.description: Why a search was bounded: the frontier kinds it met, each once.

PathOutcome.description: `reached`: a path exists within the bounds. `not-reached-complete`: the search ended with nothing left unexplored and no unresolved or truncated edge on the way, which is still only a statement about the parser's graph. `not-reached-bounded`: the search met a frontier, so absence is not established.

id.description: Digest of the node and edge sequence.

cyclic.description: Nodes on the path that belong to a call cycle (a strongly connected component of more than one node, or a self call).

resolution.description: The parser's own resolution of this edge; unresolved edges end a search and are never steps.

deferred.description: The edge was made in a callback stored for later: the call may not happen on this path's request.

sites.description: Captured call sites for this edge; empty when the parser gave none with an exact span.

PathSite.description: A call-site citation in captured bytes, from the parser's occurrence index.

ScopedReason.description: A coded reason attached to a scope (a skipped file, an unresolved frontier).

ScopeId.description: A scope reference such as `<sourceId>:<relativePath>` or a surface ID. Untrusted protocol data: bounded, free of control characters, never resolved as a filesystem path.

status.description: Coverage is separate from findings: "complete" says the check ran over its scope, not that nothing was found.

evaluator.description: Source-only owner adjudication; earlier unbound records are never upgraded to this evaluator.

validity.description: Validity as of the report's evaluation time; opening an old report never recalculates it.

ReportHistoricalFinding.description: A baseline finding the current findings do not continue, with why: resolved by a comparable check, a removed surface, unassessed in the current scope, changed detection, incomparable conditions, or an ambiguous pairing that stays open. It is never dropped, and only `resolved-by-comparable-check` says the issue is gone.

id.description: The observation's id, as the review published it.

stage.description: The stage whose unit published it.

ruleFamilyId.description: The rule family a guided review was asked about; null for a general review.

message.description: The model's statement: only in a private report of a run whose accepted secret scan matched nothing.

ReportReviewObservation.description: One model review's cited claim: proposed by a model and always drawn as one, never a finding and never coverage. Its message and its evidence pass the same disclosure profile and accepted-secret fold as a finding's.

StageId.description: A stage id: a built-in plan stage (`capture`, `review-guided`) or one a pipeline declares (`secrets`, `triage`). Lower-case words joined by single hyphens, so it never collides with a context input, which carries a dot.

ModelIdentity.description: A model's identity at the strength it is actually known, never inferred from response text.

IdentitySource.description: How a worker's identity is known. Host-reported identity is not provider attestation.

Provenance.description: What ran for one unit of a stage: which implementation, which version, where, what it read and wrote, how long, and for a model stage how many tokens and what it cost.

attempt.description: The attempt this record describes; null for work satisfied by reuse.

read.description: Every artifact the attempt was allowed to read.

invocation.description: The retained invocation record (executable digest, argv, environment names). Never a credential.

ExecutionSite.description: Where an attempt ran. `host` is a script on the owner's computer; `sandboxed-cli` an agent CLI under its sandbox.

BuiltinOperation.description: What a `builtin` stage runs: Sentinel's own capture, parse and inventory, the bounded call paths under each entry point (`walkthrough`, today's `analysis/paths`), the framework control facts, and the report.

attempt.description: The attempt this record describes; null for work satisfied by reuse.

read.description: Every artifact the attempt was allowed to read.

invocation.description: The retained invocation record (executable digest, argv, environment names). Never a credential.

ToolProvenance.description: A pinned scanner in its container.

ProvenanceImage.description: A container image as an attempt used it: the reference written and the image id actually run.

RuleFamilyId.description: A stable rule family: `sentinel.<area>.<name>` for original rules, `<vendor>.<area>.<name>` otherwise.

attempt.description: The attempt this record describes; null for work satisfied by reuse.

read.description: Every artifact the attempt was allowed to read.

invocation.description: The retained invocation record (executable digest, argv, environment names). Never a credential.

interpreter.description: `path`: the interpreter binary that ran, by absolute path, when it ran on the host.

confinement.description: `none`: a host script is unconfined by design. It runs as the owner, with the owner's file system and network, like any script the owner runs, and only while the adopted settings turn `stage.host-scripts` on.

outputSchema.description: The schema its output document was validated against before publication, by digest.

image.description: Present only when it ran in a container.

ScriptProvenance.description: A promoted script on the host or in a pinned script-runner container.

OutputSchemaId.description: A custom output's schema id, `<area>.<name>/v<n>` (`sentinel.triage/v1`). Sentinel validates the stage's output against it after the stage exits; a failed validation is a failed attempt, never a partial publication.

ScriptArgument.description: One argument passed to a script, as written. Never a credential: settings and pipelines hold none.

EnvironmentName.description: An environment variable's name as a script saw it. Values are never recorded.

attempt.description: The attempt this record describes; null for work satisfied by reuse.

read.description: Every artifact the attempt was allowed to read.

invocation.description: The retained invocation record (executable digest, argv, environment names). Never a credential.

wires.description: Every retained request wire, in order.

transcript.description: The native mode's full transcript (every tool call and read); null for a brokered stage.

deadline.description: The stage deadline and how much of it the attempt used.

AgentProvenance.description: A model stage through a CLI runner or, behind its flag, a hosted API.

AgentMode.description: `brokered`: Sentinel runs the loop and the evidence broker serves cited slices. `native`: the CLI runs its own loop over a scratch tree holding only the stage's declared inputs, and its full transcript is retained.

AgentRunnerId.description: The agent runners a stage may name. A hosted API is off unless `review.hosted-api` is on.

ModelName.description: A model name as the provider spells it.

UsageCertainty.description: Confirmed spend and unknown usage are distinct facts; a timeout never proves a provider stopped billing.

StageCost.description: What a model stage cost: always one of two answers, never nothing. `rates`: the provider has owner-entered rates and the usage was confirmed (list price, not a bill). `unobserved`: the cost is not known, with its reason, and is never printed as a zero amount. Only a model stage has a cost; Sentinel's own stages, scanners and scripts have none.

DecimalAmount.description: A non-negative decimal amount written as a string, so money is never a binary float.

CostUnobservedReason.description: Why a model stage's cost is not known: a subscription CLI reports no price, the usage itself was not confirmed, or the provider has no owner-entered rates.

ReportDefinition.description: A word the report uses, with its definition, so a recipient never needs the catalog or the product.
